name: field
title: Field (TextField, TextArea)
description: A label over a ruled line, for a line of text or a longer message, wrapping a native input or textarea that types, autofills, validates and submits without JavaScript. Quiet is the hairline rule under a writing well; warm writes on the paper itself, over a seeded pencil rule that inks from left to right on focus and under your words as you type, with a laterite exercise-book margin down a textarea; playful draws the same in accent ink with a thicker nib and wobbles on twos while you type. Counts characters near a maxlength, aloud only at 20, 10 and 0.
